sources: PTI via The Federal, Millennium Post, IPOGuru (Nov 9–10, 2026)

slides.title: MakeMyTrip gets *SEBI's nod* for India IPO
slides.stat_sub: Draft filed in July via confidential route

slides.title: Green light from *SEBI*
points: **MakeMyTrip (India)**, the Gurugram-based arm, can now float its IPO
Sellers: **parent MakeMyTrip** and its unit **ibibo Group Holdings (Singapore)**
Issue size, price band and dates will come with the **red herring prospectus**

slides.title: Who gets the *money*?
points: Parent and ibibo get **net proceeds**, not the Indian company
Planned uses: **growth, acquisitions, share and convertible buybacks**
Aims to lift **brand visibility** and help hire **tech talent**

slides.title: An OFS, *not* new capital
actual: **Public listing** of the Indian unit confirmed
slides.note: Approval is not a listing date. Size and timing are not announced. Not investment advice.

slides.title: What investors should *know*
points: **SEBI approved** MakeMyTrip India's IPO; it is an offer for sale only
The Indian unit gets **no proceeds**; parent and ibibo Singapore sell shares
**Size, price and dates** are still unknown; watch for the prospectus
